headline: Never budgeted before? Start here
lede: Everything on one tab, a step-by-step setup guide, and locked formulas.
caption: Start simple. Stay on budget.

pin.title: Beginner Budget Spreadsheet for Google Sheets and Excel
pin.description: A first budget should not need spreadsheet skills. Everything sits on one tab, a step-by-step setup guide walks you through it, and the formulas are locked, so you only fill in your numbers. A simple way to start the new year. Works in Google Sheets and Excel.
pin.alt: Dark beginner budget spreadsheet on a laptop with income, bills, expenses, savings and debt on one tab, under the headline Never budgeted before? Start here.
